description: The Portal-taxonomy columns (operating/doc_metadata_taxonomy.py COLUMNS) of the Portal's own document library, the drive SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID names (never an argument), read through the GET-only Graph adapter (integrations/graph_read.py library_columns_probe, SharePointReader.library_columns, only for a probe actor covering the whole drive): GET /drives/{drive} (the library's security class, operating/doc_metadata_taxonomy.py known_library_class of its display name; UNRESOLVED when it cannot be read), GET /drives/{drive}/list, GET /sites/{site}/lists/{list}/columns (the Portal's resolveList and column listing, plx-customer-portal scripts/document-metadata/provision-sharepoint-columns.mjs; a column is defined when its name or display name equals any definition's name or display name, the Portal's rule at :141-149 @bc6e8de) and the list items through the drive's own list, GET /drives/{drive}/list/items with $expand=fields($select=<defined mirrored columns>), walked across pages (up to 5000 items). Per Portal-taxonomy column: missing (no definition), empty (defined; none of the newest --max-items documents by lastModifiedDateTime fills it, the walk reached the list's end), filled, unknown (the column listing or the item walk was cut, so neither missing nor empty can be told) or defined_unreadable, with fill_counts over that newest-first sample (folders and other content types counted apart). fill_rule states how a value counts: null, blank text and an empty list are empty; a boolean false (CustomerVisible) and 0 count as filled. registry_sites.read names the library's site when a sharepoint.site entry of ontology/source_registry.json names it (its /sites/<name> URL name; registry names only), else registry_sites.unlisted is 1. Counts, states, registry site names and allowlisted column names only (no field values, internal names, library or list names, ids or URLs). Needs MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TENANT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET and SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID. Read-only: GET only, token POST only. Injected-transport evidence only so far: live-unverified until a live-check result exists.
notes: Split from graph.sharepoint_listitem so the AO listItem evidence stays independent of this library read. registry_sites.read binds the source registry's sharepoint.site entry of the library's site (scripts/source_registry.py LiveIndex reads only that path, credited with this check's result); the other registry sites are named by capture.sharepoint_estate. sample.complete false means the item walk stopped at its bound: a column no read document fills is then unknown, never empty. The sample is the newest --max-items documents, so a column only older documents fill reads empty.
